<function name="OnMousePressed" parent="PANEL" type="hook">
	<description>Called whenever a mouse key was pressed while the panel is focused.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="keyCode" type="number">They key code of the key pressed, see <page>Enums/MOUSE</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to suppress default action such as right click opening edit menu for <page>DTextEntry</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
